chapter: Postwar years, accident and lean times
title: Sam Price as pianist and 'genius' organizer
summary: Autrey calls Sam Price a hard-driving jam pianist and a salesman who could sell the Empire State Building, who often called him for record dates.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I see, but wasn't Sam sort of organizing dates for Decca at that time?
Yes. Yes, he worked -- (Laughs) -- oh man, what an operator! Do you know Sam Price?
Yeah, I know Sam Price.
(Laughter.)
And I'm not very sure about him.
Oh, what an operator!
He's a survivor, that's what I call Sam.
(Whistles.) Oh man, Sam was a -- Hm?
When -- how long have you known Sam?
Oh, man, I've known Sam for so many years, too many years.
(Laughter.)
Oh, son of a gun. But I mean, you know, I don't know.
Well, now, what do you think of Sam as a pianist? This is aside from an organizer. We'll get to that, but as a pianist, how do you feel about Sam?
Well, he's a good jam artist. He kicks the hell out of what he knows, or what he does. He does it damn well. I've got to give the man that, you know. No, I -- uh, hmmm, well --
And as an organizer?
As a -- well that's a different thing. As an organizer, yeah, he's -- he's a genius.
(Laughter.)
Because if you listen, if you don't talk
and listen to Sam, now he can sell you the Empire State Building. You know.
(Laughter.)
And he does. He has done it. Many times.
It's still there.
Oh, well, I mean, but he's sold it.
Right.
People bought it.
Right (laughs).

Oh, man, Sam is Somethin' Sammy and -- he plays -- he plays damn well when he plays. I mean, you know, and he's a hard worker. He's not one of those guys sit there and say what the hell, I don't feel like it tonight. He's in there blowing. I mean now for what it's worth, you've got it. He turns it loose. He doesn't hold back on it.
You may not like it, after you hear it, but he gives his all. I give a man that, you know.
Do you remember the recording date you did with Sam? How you got involved in it?
Hmm, well, no, yes and no. I've done several with him, and he's always called me for a date. You know.
Uh-huh. I see.
So I don't remember any particular
date, but he's called me, any time, you know?
